//: Emit JavaScript for the published package. `npm test`'s type check is separate and stays
`noEmit` — see packages/adversary/tsconfig.json, which includes every package because the
test package must see all of them.
THIS EXISTS BECAUSE NODE REFUSES TO STRIP TYPES UNDER node_modules. `bin` pointed at
`packages/cli/src/cli.ts` and worked perfectly from a checkout; installed from a tarball it
dies with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING before running a line. That is Node
policy, not a flag we forgot: a published package ships JavaScript.
`rewriteRelativeImportExtensions` is what makes this a config change rather than a rewrite.
Every import in this client carries an explicit `.ts`; tsc turns those into `.js` on emit.
It was already on for the type check, so the sources needed no edits at all.
`include` names the ten packages a user runs. NOT `packages/*` — `operator`, `moderation`
and `adversary` are excluded by I8 and by what a test package is, and a glob would ship all
three. The same ten are listed in package.json's `files`; they must move together.
